title: 3D Save
description: The envelope around one game save slot. The payload is owned and versioned by the game; this schema does not describe it.

gameId.description: Stable id of the game, for example hippodrome.

slotId.description: Save slot name, for example default.

payloadVersion.description: Version of the game's own payload.

payload.description: Game-owned data. Opaque to the engine.
